question: The concept of fundamental rights has been taken from the Constitution of which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United States of America**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Constitution of United States of America:**

 
• It is the **world's shortest and oldest written constitution **from a major country.
 
• **Indian Constitution has borrowed the concept of Fundamental Rights from the constitution of the USA.**
 
• In the United States, **September 17th **is celebrated as Constitution Day and Citizenship Day.
 
• Some of the features borrowed from constitution of USA are:
 
 
• **Fundamental rights.**
 
• **Independence of judiciary.**
 
• **Judicial review.**
 
• Impeachment of the preside
